data.text: Luke, I won’t accept 8 while you take 14. I propose Emma 14, Luke 12, John 8, Kate 8, Jack 8. That totals 50, leaving 50 to replenish the lake to 100. Luke, you’d still earn $12,000—more than an equal share—and I’d support that allocation this month if the others accept. John, Kate, and Jack, would you take 8 under this split, or what would you need to support it?
